title: Veterans Law Reference Library & Retroactive Screening Rule Card (v2.0)
description: Frontmatter schema for cataloging Title 38 statutes, historical 38 C.F.R. provisions, bitemporal CUE vs. open-claim scope, CAVC/Fed. Cir. precedents, VASRD diffs, and law-firm playbooks.

title.description: Human-readable title of the playbook, era lens, treatise, or CFR historical diff.

category.description: Primary Diataxis document classification in the repository.

effective_from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the applicable statutory/regulatory window.

effective_to.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'present' if currently in force.

bitemporal_scope.description: Judicial-interpretation temporal scope under George v. McDonough, 596 U.S. 740 (2022) and 38 C.F.R. § 20.1403(e).

practice_domains.description: Veterans law-firm case domains addressed by this module.

vasrd_system.description: Canonical 38 C.F.R. Part 4 body system classification (if applicable).

statutes.description: Title 38 or Title 10/28/31 U.S.C. sections implicated (e.g., '38 U.S.C. § 5109A').

cfr_citations.description: 38 C.F.R. citations (both current and historical section numbers).

key_precedents.description: Controlling SCOTUS, Fed. Cir., CAVC, and VAOPGCPREC citations.

retro_pathways.description: Procedural and substantive legal pathways used to establish entitlement or retroactive effective dates.

c_file_triggers.description: Specific VA form numbers, code sheet notations, or clinical terms that trigger an audit.

kill_switches.description: Factual or legal conditions that defeat the theory (e.g., BVA subsumption, George v. McDonough CUE bar).

unfinalized_proposals.description: Watchlist of unfinalized proposed rules or rescinded IFRs that must NOT be cited as active law (e.g., RIN 2900-AQ72, RIN 2900-AQ82, 90 FR 46542, 91 FR 7118).

verification_status.description: Audit confidence level against Federal Register / U.S. Reports / Vet. App. reporters.
